candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (transport ReadTimeout ~2.0s); order's own call to payment also times out, so the latency originates downstream of order at payment.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side telemetry absent; cannot confirm payment is the slow hop versus order's own timeout budget.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502 with order client ReadTimeout ~2s, and order's payment call also ReadTimeout; inventory/redis succeed fast. Logs and metrics corroborate ~2s checkout 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->payment path. Payment-side evidence missing, so bounded to downstream latency.
